forecast.generalSituationZh: 隨著東北季候風在今日稍為緩和，廣東沿岸氣溫回升。預料高空擾動會在未來一兩日為華南帶來驟雨，局部地區有雷暴。受一股偏東氣流影響，下週初廣東沿岸較為潮濕，部分地區能見度較低。預料一道冷鋒會在下週中後期抵達廣東，受隨後的東北季候風影響，該區北風增強，氣溫顯著下降。
forecast.generalSituationEn: With the northeast monsoon moderating slightly today, temperatures will rise over the coast of Guangdong. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring showers and isolated thunderstorms to southern China in the next couple of days. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be relatively humid over the coast of Guangdong early next week, with relatively low visibility in some areas. A cold front is expected to reach Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, winds will strengthen from the north and temperatures will fall significantly over the region.
